question: Was the 2016 closure of the FS.TO online cinema permanent, given that fs.to is now listed as a first-party S.EE file-sharing domain?
why: No first-party closure statement is reachable; the 2016 seizure is a news report, while the first-party page now names fs.to as an S.EE sharing domain, so $.free_tier.stated was kept at its current value.
